data_manifest.split_policy: contiguous 90/5/5 percent character ranges; tokenize each separately; no boundary-spanning examples
data_manifest.limitations: Character boundaries may divide a scene or word; source overlap is prevented, semantic independence is not guaranteed.
data_manifest.test_policy: test tokens excluded from training and checkpoint selection

protocol.parameters: all parameters including tied input/output embedding
protocol.dropout: disabled in both arms to isolate loss intervention
protocol.evaluation: token-weighted validation; context resets per sequence block; each target scored once; test unused
protocol.timing: synchronized wall forward/backward/optimizer; includes first-step state initialization; evaluation and loading excluded
protocol.selection: no cross-run selection; checkpoints optional; larger validation evaluation still required
